"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Republican Party is committed to Nobel Laureate Aung San Suu Kyi and other democratic leaders whose election in 1990 was brutally suppressed and who have been arrested and imprisoned for their belief in freedom and democracy.",
